title: Conditional GAN discriminator
description: A conditional discriminator with two named inputs and two named outputs. The one-hot label `y` is projected onto a 28×28 plane and stacked on the image `x` as a second channel; two "down2" convolutions reduce the result to a 128×7×7 map. The flattened map is published as `features` for a feature-matching loss, and the head produces raw `logits` — apply a sigmoid, or use BCEWithLogitsLoss, in the loss rather than in the network.
reference: Mirza & Osindero, "Conditional Generative Adversarial Nets" (2014), in the usual DCGAN form; 10·784+784 + 2·64·4·4+64 + 64·128·4·4 + 2·128 + 6272+1 = 148,337 parameters.
